Veryable Careers

Data Engineer

Data Engineer

Data Engineer

Join Veryable, a trailblazing platform revolutionizing manufacturing and empowering individuals to thrive through flexible work.

Overview

At Veryable, we are building a platform that is transforming the manufacturing industry. We solve big problems, and in doing so, we provide a new way for people to find work, develop skills, and better their lives. We're proud of and excited about the work we do, and we are looking for passionate, driven data engineers to help advance and improve our work.

Veryable is seeking an entry-level Data Engineer to join our Data team. This hands-on role is for an individual who enjoys building reliable systems, maintaining the data pipelines and platform our analytics and machine learning teams rely on. It is an early-career role with room to grow alongside a growing data organization.

Please note that Veryable will not be able to sponsor U.S. work authorization for this position. All applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. now and in the future.

What you'll do

· Build and maintain data pipelines that move data from source systems into Snowflake

· Support the data platform, including orchestration, automated testing, and CI/CD for data workflows

· Partner with our data scientists to build and operate machine learning pipelines, from feature preparation to model deployment

· Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability and performance

· Work with analysts and business teams to make sure data is accurate, documented, and easy to use

· Write clean, tested, version-controlled code

Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

· Proficiency in SQL and Python

· Understanding of data pipelines, ETL/ELT concepts, and relational data modeling

· Familiarity with Git and version control workflows

· Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn

· Able to work in-office at our headquarters in Downtown Dallas

Preferred Qualifications

· 1+ year of experience in data engineering or a related role, including internships

· Hands-on experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

· Exposure to CI/CD tools, workflow orchestration, or integration platforms

· Exposure to machine learning workflows or MLOps

Compensation

$85,000 - $105,000 base salary, depending on experience

About Veryable

At Veryable, our mission is to accelerate next generation capabilities in the manufacturing and logistics space by enabling businesses to scale production in real-time to changing needs and conditions.

The journey to the next generation of manufacturing and logistics starts with addressing labor as the first critical constraint in meeting production demand. Our co-founders had a vision of making the gig economy accessible to manufacturing and distribution through both a mobile app for workers and a suite of business tools for companies to assess their labor needs and access labor when they need it. This technological innovation has allowed businesses to address the routine variability of their production demand with labor that is available just in time.

Veryable is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Veryable abides by all laws deemed constitutional and does not discriminate on the basis of vaccine choices or violate your personal healthcare privacy.
